parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels providing rigidity and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other components such as doors, drawers, shelves, and the base, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the entire structure together.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the frame with hinges, allowing access to the storage space inside.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a cover for the internal storage area, protecting contents from dust and maintaining a clean appearance.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a box-like component made of solid wood, designed to slide in and out of the cabinet frame.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for storing smaller items and provides easy access through a handle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along metal or wooden rails, sliding in and out of the cabinet.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board placed inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space into sections for organizing stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and supports the weight of the entire cabinet and its contents.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that remains fixed to the floor or surface.
